description: This script is a utility for cleaning up download directories in OpenWrt projects, deleting older versions of tarballs while keeping the latest.

classes.name: Entry
classes.description: Represents a file or directory entry with methods to parse version info, delete files, and get paths.

methods.name: parseVer_1234
methods.description: Parses version string of format major.minor.patch.revision.

methods.name: parseVer_123
methods.description: Parses version string with optional patchlevel.

methods.name: parseVer_12
methods.description: Parses version string with major and minor.

methods.name: parseVer_ymd_GIT_SHASUM
methods.description: Parses version with date and GIT SHA sum.

methods.name: parseVer_GIT
methods.description: Uses file modification time as version.

methods.name: usage
methods.description: Displays usage information for the script.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function to handle command-line arguments, process files, and delete old versions.
